name: St. Regis Hotel, San Francisco
insider_take: The St. Regis San Francisco stands as the city's most prestigious address, where Old World elegance meets Silicon Valley innovation in the heart of SoMa.
whats_special: This tower of luxury sits on the exact spot where newspaper magnate William Randolph Hearst once built his grand Examiner Building. The hotel's signature Bloody Mary was actually invented at the original St. Regis New York in 1934, and their expert bartenders continue this legacy with the finest ingredients. Each suite features floor-to-ceiling windows offering breathtaking views of the Bay Bridge, while the building's seismic engineering makes it one of the safest skyscrapers on the West Coast.
pro_tip: Book a bay-view suite on floors 35-40 for unobstructed sunrise views over the Oakland Hills, and ask your St. Regis Butler about accessing the exclusive helipad for helicopter tours.
dont_miss: The hotel's Remède Spa features a unique "Gold Dust" facial using actual 24-karat gold particles, while Goko Restaurant showcases the largest sake collection on the West Coast. Walk two blocks to discover the hidden Rincon Park with its stunning bay views, or explore the historic Ferry Building Marketplace just 10 minutes away for artisanal foods and weekend farmers markets.
pros: Prime SOMA location near museums and financial district
